problem_text:
A logistics company is selecting cargo containers to load onto a transport aircraft. Available containers are:
* Container 1: weight 22 kg, revenue $130
* Container 2: weight 22 kg, revenue $254
* Container 3: weight 36 kg, revenue $210
* Container 4: weight 36 kg, revenue $108
* Container 5: weight 15 kg, revenue $210
* Container 6: weight 5 kg, revenue $258
* Container 7: weight 32 kg, revenue $18
* Container 8: weight 29 kg, revenue $110
* Container 9: weight 1 kg, revenue $110
* Container 10: weight 15 kg, revenue $168
* Container 11: weight 39 kg, revenue $274
* Container 12: weight 11 kg, revenue $56
* Container 13: weight 32 kg, revenue $211
* Container 14: weight 26 kg, revenue $98
* Container 15: weight 2 kg, revenue $41
* Container 16: weight 5 kg, revenue $60
* Container 17: weight 32 kg, revenue $58
* Container 18: weight 5 kg, revenue $114
* Container 19: weight 26 kg, revenue $174
* Container 20: weight 18 kg, revenue $38
* Container 21: weight 49 kg, revenue $266
* Container 22: weight 38 kg, revenue $253
* Container 23: weight 34 kg, revenue $288
* Container 24: weight 48 kg, revenue $177
* Container 25: weight 42 kg, revenue $60
* Container 26: weight 43 kg, revenue $184
* Container 27: weight 50 kg, revenue $142
* Container 28: weight 2 kg, revenue $148
* Container 29: weight 4 kg, revenue $27

The aircraft has a maximum payload capacity of 503 kg. Determine which containers to load to maximize total revenue without exceeding this weight limit. Each container must be either fully loaded or left behind.
